world_news.headline: Iran war live: Hegseth survives impeachment bid; Iran denies US talks
world_news.summary: Despite bipartisan opposition to the war, a bid to impeach Hegseth fails as Iran denies talks with US.

world_news.headline: Fire contained on platform in Iran’s South Pars gas field
world_news.summary: Officials are considering a gas leak or an operational mishap as possible causes of the fire, Fars news agency said.

world_news.headline: Massive fire as Israeli settlers burn down business near Nablus
world_news.summary: Israeli settlers have set fire to Palestinian property in the village of Luban ash-Sharqiya, near Nablus.

world_news.headline: French far-right author Zemmour launches second presidential bid
world_news.summary: Zemmour seeks to expel 'foreign unemployed people' after last month's violent protests.

world_news.headline: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair
world_news.summary: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.

world_news.headline: Russia expels Moldovan diplomat in tit-for-tat move
world_news.summary: Relations between Moscow and Chisinau have worsened since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

world_news.headline: US House Republicans reject effort to impeach Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth
world_news.summary: Hegseth has been accused of spearheading war on Iran without required congressional approval.

world_news.headline: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
world_news.summary: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.

world_news.headline: UNIFIL patrol comes under fire in southern Lebanon
world_news.summary: UNIFIL said on Tuesday that 'about a dozen rounds' were fired at one of its patrols, without identifying the assailants.

world_news.headline: US poll shows death penalty lost majority support for first time since 1971
world_news.summary: Support for capital punishment has been declining in the US for years over concerns about fairness and racial bias.
